verdict.rationale: The enterprise-readiness docs list regional endpoints as a deployment and data-residency option, and the self-hosting docs describe BYOC deployment on AWS, Azure, or GCP that keeps data under the customer's control. Customers can therefore choose where their data lives, but the regional-endpoint option is only a one-line mention, and residency control appears to depend on self-hosting or enterprise deployment. missing for 10: documentation of which regions are available and how to select them on the managed SaaS, evidence that residency choice is available outside enterprise or self-hosted plans, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
